description: Reviewed, intentional changes to protected production files. A protected file that differs from the validated baseline is accepted only when BOTH its baseline hash and its current hash match an entry here; any other edit still makes a test INVALID. Add an entry only after the change's tests pass.

changes.title: freshness watchdog hold-and-resume (RuntimeConfig.stale_resume_s, default 0 = original stop)
changes.summary: Adds an opt-in watchdog response. With stale_resume_s = 0 (default and every existing caller) the runtime stops exactly as before. With stale_resume_s > 0, the 400 ms freshness trip commands zero velocity at the same moment but keeps the alignment; the next fresh frame resumes it, and the run ends as stale_camera only if no fresh frame arrives within stale_resume_s. Adds counters watchdog_pauses, watchdog_resumes, paused_s and paused_motion_ticks, and pause/resume events.
